beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley's back a few days later, still waiting to hear back about the songs.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You set the Empress back down between you.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "So does this card mean the songs are definitely going to take off?"

options.text: No — it's not a guarantee, it's about something being ready to grow.
It has nothing to do with the songs at all.

elaboration: The Empress never promises the harvest. It just says something real is ready to grow — what becomes of it from here is still unfolding.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "What if I push too hard trying to make it perfect before I send anything else?"

options.text: Let it flourish instead of forcing it — that's the abundance this card points to.
Forcing it is the only way it'll ever be good enough.
Pushing harder never changes anything either way.

elaboration: Abundance that comes from allowing things to flourish, not forcing them — gripping it tighter usually shrinks it instead.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I don't even know if I'm doing this right — nobody ever taught me how to actually write a song."

options.text: You don't need the technique yet — nourish it and let it grow.
Then you shouldn't be doing this at all.
Technique doesn't matter, so don't think about it.

elaboration: Nourish, protect, and grow whatever you're tending — the Empress cares more about tending it than about doing it by the book.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "My bandmates think I'm being selfish, disappearing to work on my own stuff."

options.text: That's not selfish — it's a reminder to care for yourself first.

elaboration: A reminder to love and care for yourself first — that's not a footnote on this card, it's half the message.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Is it weird that I actually love just sitting with the guitar for hours — like, physically love it?"

options.text: Not weird at all — pleasure and the body are part of the message here.
You should feel guilty enjoying it that much.
Enjoyment doesn't belong in a reading.

elaboration: Pleasure, beauty, and the body are not indulgences — they're part of the message. Loving how it feels to make something isn't a distraction from the Empress, it's the card itself.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: One more thing — the Empress doesn't rush the harvest. Something worth growing takes exactly as long as it takes.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "That makes sense. I think I get it now — I don't have to force this into something finished, I just have to keep tending it and let it grow at its own pace. Thank you, really."
